messages.content: Answer with a list of items, instead of bullet points use -. No two consecutive words can share the same first letter. write a description of the 20th century in an over-dramatic, biblical style

message.content:
- The age began
- With thunderous noise
- And iron smoke
- Devoured the skies
- Men marched
- Into dark trenches
- Where blood soaked
- The frozen earth
- Then war returned
- To shatter hope
- Cities burned
- Beneath black ash
- Shadows lengthened
- Over silent streets
- Yet light emerged
- From broken ruins
- New stars rose
- Above the dust
